newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian Feb electricity demand up 1.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Italian Feb electricity demand up 1.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Italian electricity consumption rose a seasonally and calendar adjusted 1.5 percent in February compared to the same month last year, utility company Enel said on Friday.
Enel said some 21.6 billion kWh of electricity was used last month. On an unadjusted basis, consumption fell 3.3 percent.
In the first two months of the year, electricity demand rose an adjusted one percent, Enel said. On an unadjusted basis, consumption fell 1.8 percent.
Net national production in February was 18.6 billion kWh, down 4.3 percent on the year. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
